messages.author: 9548b9e0c8258268
messages.subject: unmarked 0.8-3 released
parts:
Hi unmarkedsters,

I'm pleased to announce the release of unmarked 0.8-3. A full list of
changes can be found by reviewing the commit history at
http://github.com/ianfiske/unmarked. The most important new features
are:

1. Non-parametric boostrapping can now be used to derive standard
errors for any of the unmarked model fits or subsequent linearComb()
and backTransform() estimates. For example, continuing from the
occu() example as so:

> example(occu)
> fm <- nonparboot(fm, B = 50)
> vcov(fm, method = "nonparboot")
> SE(fm, method = "nonparboot")
> det.at.obshalf <- backTransform(linearComb(fm, type = "det", c(1, 0.5)))
> SE(det.at.obshalf)

2. You can now compute both smoothed and projected trajectories from
colext() model fits. Simply use smoothed(fm) or projected(fm) to
extract trajectories. You can also compute standard errors for these
quantities with a non-parametric bootstrap:

> example(colext)
> fm <- nonparboot(fm, B = 50) ## this is slow!
> smoothed(fm)
> f...@smoothed.mean.bsse ## get the bootstrap standard error

Best,
Ian
